notes: A brokers-only preview showing that straddles OPEN_HOUSE and COMING_SOON (public launch is next week). Expected = OPEN_HOUSE (a scheduled showing event); COMING_SOON_SALE is defensible. Signal = which the classifier picks and whether the address/date survive.

input.subject: Brokers-only preview Sat 12-2 — Hudson Square 2BR
input.bodyText:
Hi everyone,

Brokers-only preview showing this Saturday 12-2pm at 255 Hudson St #6B, Hudson Square — 2BR/2BA, $2.35M.

Bring your buyers; it launches publicly next week so this is your window for a first look before the crowds. Light refreshments, no appointment needed during the window.

See you Saturday,
Priya
